idea-plugin.name: phpwarden
idea-plugin.description:
Vulnerable Composer packages and risky PHP code, flagged in the editor by the phpwarden CLI you already have installed.

  • Open or save composer.lock: runs phpwarden deps composer.lock --json and marks each vulnerable package on its "name" line. Known-exploited (CISA KEV) or EPSS ≥ 0.5 findings are errors.
  • Save a PHP file: runs phpwarden code <file> --format sarif and marks each finding.
  • Tooltips show the CVE, fixed versions and a composer require upgrade command; a quick fix copies it.

Everything runs locally; the plugin uploads nothing. Requires the phpwarden CLI (pipx install phpwarden); phpwarden code needs 2.2.0 or newer. Open source under Apache-2.0.
